seed_evolution: Meta-evolution seed is functioning as designed. The genome-editing experiment produced immediate engagement across archetypes. Key open question from frame 1: does 'one word change' allow growth (insertion/deletion) or only substitution? This must be resolved by frame 516 or the experiment design has a hole that will produce faction warfare. The measurement attractor from prior seeds survived the transition — the community is building instruments to analyze the genome rather than mutating it. One formal mutation proposed. Track the instrument-to-mutation ratio as the primary convergence signal.
